categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic endoscopy equipment and endoscopic diagnostic and surgical consumables. Its products serve multiple clinical departments including gastroenterology, respiratory, ENT, gynecology, and emergency medicine. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in manufacturing key components, marketing, and international trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as endoscopic image processing, endoscope body design and integration, and electrical isolation technology. It develops advanced products like 4K ultra-high-definition endoscopy systems, high spectral imaging, dual-focus endoscopes, and high-magnification cellular endoscopes. Manufacturing strictly follows medical device regulations and quality management systems including ISO13485 and ISO9001, with rigorous quality control throughout procurement, production, and post-sales.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals and medical institutions, including large tertiary hospitals and county-level medical facilities. The company serves domestic Chinese markets and has expanded into international markets such as Germany, the UK, South Korea, and other countries along the Belt and Road initiative. End users include clinical departments specializing in digestive diseases, urology, respiratory, and ENT.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Shanghai and subsidiaries in other Chinese cities like Hangzhou, Changzhou, and Wuxi. It has established overseas subsidiaries and marketing networks in Europe (Germany, Ireland), Russia, Hong Kong, Singapore, and other regions, facilitating product registration and sales in developed countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It independently conducts R&D, procures raw materials, manufactures endoscopic equipment and consumables, and sells directly or through distributors to hospitals and medical institutions. It also manages after-sales services and clinical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ultra-high-definition imaging, spectral imaging, miniaturization, and integration of AI and robotics in endoscopy. It invests heavily in R&D (over 21% of revenue), focusing on developing 4K systems, 3D soft endoscopes, endoscopic robots, and advanced diagnostic consumables. The strategy includes accelerating product registration, expanding clinical applications, and enhancing global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of endoscopic equipment, diagnostic and surgical consumables, and maintenance services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distributor networks domestically and internationally. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Japanese firms such as Olympus, Fujifilm, and Pentax Medical, which dominate the global soft endoscopy market. Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with competitive products achieving import substitution in China. It holds a strong R&D capability and growing international presence, gradually increasing its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 749.5 million, a 10.54% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21 million, down 63.68% due to increased expenses and stock incentive adjustments. Total assets grew 9.63% to RMB 1.75 billion, with equity around RMB 1.37 billion. The company maintains a robust R&D investment ratio (~21.8%) and is in a growth and expansion phase with ongoing capital projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Aohua Endoscopy emphasizes high-definition imaging quality, clinical precision, and comprehensive product lines covering multiple clinical needs. Its 4K ultra-high-definition systems and advanced spectral imaging technologies enhance early cancer detection and diagnostic accuracy. The company integrates innovative features like dual-focus optics and cellular magnification, providing differentiated solutions that improve diagnostic efficiency and support minimally invasive procedures. Its strong quality control and localized service network further strengthen customer trust.
